title_zh: 核对摄影比赛资格后决定提交

scenario.label_zh: 核对摄影比赛参赛与提交要求
scenario.goal_zh: 确认照片资格、正确截止日与线上提交方式，决定在截止前提交但不声称已完成

context_zh: 业余摄影者询问比赛工作人员，确认其照片是否符合赛事规则及如何提交。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I'd like to enter the photography contest, but my picture has already appeared on my own website. Is that allowed?

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Yes. Our rules only exclude photographs that have already won a prize in another competition.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Good. There's also a conflict between the closing date on the poster and the one on the entry form.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: The form is correct: entries close on Friday. We'll replace the old poster today.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Can I send the image online, or do you need a print?

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Use the online form. For your convenience, the upload instructions are on the same page.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll read those and submit the image before Friday.

targets.sense_zh: 信息之间的不一致或冲突
